hero.sub: A neighbourhood café at Chapel Gate, Ballincollig — pulling shots and plating traybakes to help fund the charity shop next door.

categories.label: Breakfast
categories.desc: Fry-ups, toast, and the all-day breakfast board — served from open till close.

categories.label: Sandwiches
categories.desc: Made to order at the counter, on whatever's fresh that morning.

categories.label: Jacket Potatoes
categories.desc: Old reliable. A few fillings, always done properly.

categories.label: Cakes & Traybakes
categories.desc: Baked in-house and changing with whoever was in the kitchen that day.

categories.label: Coffee
categories.desc: Java Republic beans. Oat, almond, and soya milk on request, no charge for asking.

difference.sectionLabel: The other half of the building
difference.headline: This café pays a wage next door
difference.body: Chapel Gate Café is a social enterprise — every coffee sold helps fund Balance, the charity shop right beside us that supports adults with special needs. You're not just buying a scone. You're keeping the lights on for the shop next door.
